findings.finding: Both quotations resolve exactly. The source supports 4,000 prompts across ten cultures, five evaluated models, three metrics and a 500-prompt mitigation subset. The stated 88%, 89.70% and 82.54% results are reported for the named conditions.

Generative_KI and Prompting follow from interview-script generation and inference-time FIP/MFA interventions. Bias_Ungleichheit, Diversitaet and Fairness follow from the explicitly measured cultural insider-outsider disparity and mitigation; Gender and Soziale_Arbeit are correctly excluded as study domains.

The limited culture set, text-only output, absent systematic multilingual analysis and scale constraints are source-grounded. Several appendix formulas are undecoded, but the reviewed benchmark and mitigation claims resolve in prose and linearised tables and do not rely on those formulas.
